title: Recover only exact verified operational record transactions
statement: The Work records Module shall establish ordinary transaction outcomes through supported storage recovery without guessing, semantic replay or rollback of committed work.

what.problem: Lost output or interrupted writes can leave a caller uncertain whether its decision was committed.
what.desired_outcome: A coherent current state or explicit safe unavailability allows a fresh decision without replaying old semantic intent.

why.rationale: SR-045 requires establishing the already determined storage outcome without selecting a new engineering effect or rolling back committed work.

stakeholders: Actors resolving an interrupted recorded update
Consumers relying on acknowledged saved results

conditions: An ordinary command opens the associated supported SQLite store after interruption.
The storage engine cannot establish a coherent outcome or maintenance has fenced the store.

contexts: IF-003 ordinary current-state reads and transactions backed by SQLite WAL recovery.
Explicit replacement resume remains a separate maintenance operation with preserved prior and staged units.

how.approach: Apply the current v4 SQLite task and maintenance contract. Open only an associated supported database; corruption or unsupported state yields explicit unavailability without guessed repair.

how_much.scope: This allocation preserves its existing parent SR and accountable Module. Prior v3 file-journal mechanisms are historical at 39be9c81; current maintenance remains separately explicit.

acceptance_criteria: Open only an associated supported database; corruption or unsupported state yields explicit unavailability without guessed repair.
Storage-engine recovery establishes the already determined ordinary transaction outcome without replaying actor decisions.
Current inspection returns a coherent committed/prior snapshot and opaque revision when established, not a synthetic recovery approval.
Committed work cannot be rolled back to repair an absent response; uncommitted work cannot become success by retry inference.
Repeated inspection after interruption has no duplicate semantic effects; uncertain outcome remains explicitly uncertain.
Explicit staged store restoration/import recovery belongs to the maintenance contract, with fence, observed state, exact candidate and preserved prior units.
constraints: Current v4 SQLite realization; source observations do not establish engineering approval or passing implementation proof.

sources.basis: Derived from SR-045 for the proposed MOD-011 responsibility. Allocates SR-045 exact recovery, foreign-content preservation, acknowledged-commit limits, interruption, and retirement outcomes to FUNC-047. AR-023 owns explicit public selection and non-recovery command dispatch. These criteria specify intended observations, not executed product evidence or an adoption of the REM authoring format by the CLI.
